synthesis_decision.rationale: [blinded_slot:candidate_b->antithesis] Both candidates met the 1e-5 gap and 600-node limits on the same two public instances. A reported gaps of 1.47e-9 and 9.29e-7 in 3 and 9 nodes; B reported 4.29e-13 and 4.51e-13 in 3 and 1 nodes. B also verified the exact return schema, box feasibility, and the objective recomputed with the strict |w_j| > 1e-9 threshold. The clean-container mechanical metrics are all null, so these are branch-reported results. | B is preferred because it used fewer nodes on the second public instance and demonstrated that coupled pair and triplet bounds plus activation-cou

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: A diagonal curvature minorant and single-indicator branching suffice under the 600-node cap for correlated and interchangeable features.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: All three independent-block cases failed; one near-duplicate case still had a 0.743889 gap at 600 nodes.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Independent coordinate envelopes discard joint curvature and activation choices; the fixed-box coordinate solver also stopped too far from stationarity on some near-duplicate supports.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Retain certified coupled curvature and solve fixed boxes with a bounded least-squares active-set method.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Pairwise disjunctions are sufficient for tightly correlated groups of three under the node cap.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: The three near-triplet cases had gaps of 0.574123, 0.200628, and 0.0837515 at 600 nodes.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Pairing separates at least one member of each triplet from the other two, weakening both the curvature minorant and the joint activation bound.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Keep three-column curvature and minimize the eight local activation modes jointly.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Local disjunctions without a global count constraint close the certificate for nearly rank-one designs within 600 nodes.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: The common-factor seed 705 retained a gap of 0.048122 at 600 nodes; conditioning on total activation count reduced the gap to 4.46e-5 before branching on individual indicators.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Local activation choices do not constrain the total number of paid features needed to fit the shared direction.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Partition by paid count, use sorted activation increments for the dual, and branch only within unresolved counts.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Selecting either pair or triplet curvature for the whole design suffices on mixed correlated groups.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: Mixed seeds 832 and 833 retained gaps of 0.364138 and 0.00649579 at 600 nodes.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: The triplet path treats leftover pairs as singletons, while the pair path splits triplets.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Retain both pair and triplet disjunctions in the same PSD minorant.

api_quick_reference.signature: cauchy_linear_fit(design: np.ndarray, values: np.ndarray, *, scale: float | None=None, noise_floor: float=1e-08) -> tuple[np.ndarray, float]
api_quick_reference.doc_summary: Fit finite design (n,p) and values (n,) with n >= p >= 1, full column rank before and after weighting, and positive scale if supplied and positive floor, returning (coefficients (p,), floored residual MAD).
mathematical_preconditions: Inputs are finite real arrays convertible to float64, with magnitudes that keep intermediate residuals, model evaluations, and least-squares calculations representable. The linear fit requires a nonempty (n,p) design and an (n,) response with n >= p >= 1 and numerical full column rank, including after Cauchy row weighting. Supplied scale and noise_floor must be positive finite scalars.

The relaxation fit requires aligned length-n vectors, n >= 4, strictly increasing nonnegative times measured from the supplied onset, and a predictor numerically independent of the intercept. The onset rate is independently specified and nonnegative, noise_scale is positive, curvature_ratio is nonnegative, 2 <= bins <= n, and 0 < tau_min < tau_max. The saturation branch requires a positive onset rate, a numerically full-rank fitted Jacobian, and a positive slope not active at its lower bound.

The step fit requires aligned length-n vectors and a nonempty integer vector of candidate split indices, each leaving at least three samples on either side. Each candidate design must have full column rank: the predictor cannot be constant within both segments. The scale and loss_clip are positive finite scalars. Interpretation as a level step assumes a shared local trend on both sides.
